# Q3 Roadmap
Owner: Priya Nair · Status: In progress

## Goals
- Ship per-tenant rate limiting (acme/api#482)
- Move billing webhooks to the new queue
- Reduce p99 latency on /v2/search below 250 ms

## Milestones
| Milestone | Owner | Due | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tenant limits GA | Priya | Sep 30 | On track |
| Webhook queue migration | Tomasz | Oct 14 | At risk |
| Search latency budget | Mira | Oct 21 | On track |
| Node 22 upgrade | Sam | Oct 28 | Not started |

## Risks
- The queue migration depends on infra capacity in eu-west-1.
- The latency work needs a stable benchmark environment.

## Decisions
- Rate limits fail open when Redis is unreachable.
- Deprecated /v1 endpoints are removed after the Q4 freeze.

## Open questions
- Do we expose per-tenant limits in the public API docs?
- Who owns the on-call runbook for the new queue?
